correctness.rationale: For k≥2 flexible leaves and h=a+b≥2 stubborn leaves under the exact independent-clock, one-sided partial-averaging protocol, stationary means equal m=(az0+bz1)/h and q=ab(z1−z0)²/h²>0. Direct quadratic-generator moment equations reduce to v,u,w,z with z=w and give the claimed explicit common cross-covariance C=qθ[(k+h)(2−θ)+θ]/D, D=k(θ²−8θ+8)+h(2θ²−8θ+8)+2θ−θ²>0, and both variance formulas. Independent SymPy rational-function subtraction gives C(k+1)−C(k)=−qθ²[hθ²−(2h+4)θ+4]/(Dk Dk+1), with a single root θh=(h+2−√(h²+4))/h; exact variance differences, leaf Pearson correlation increment and E[(L1−L2)²]=2hqθ²/D also follow. Thus sign reversal is universal in k and independent of stubborn opinion split, while normalized correlation rises regardless of θ. Claims concern stationary ensemble moments, not temporal correlations or arbitrary networks.
